title: Zach Ertz: I don't want torn ACL to be my last play

sources.name: Pro Football Talk
sources.title: Zach Ertz: I don't want torn ACL to be my last play
sources.description: A report in February indicated that tight end Zach Ertz wants to play in 2026 and Ertz has confirmed that his plan is to return for a 14th NFL season.
